cues.en: You have to forgive me. I'm not familiar with the local custom.
cues.zh: 请原谅我。我不熟悉当地习俗。

cues.en: you always say amen after you hear a prayer
cues.zh: 你听完祈祷后总会说阿们

cues.en: because that's what you just heard,
just heard the prayer for the dead,
cues.zh: 刚才听到的是亡者祈祷，

cues.en: I didn't kill it. Don't blame me.
It was dead when I got here.
cues.zh: 我来的时候它就已经不行了。

cues.en: For even if the prayers were answered and a miracle occurred
cues.zh: 就算祈祷得到回应，奇迹真的发生，

cues.en: and the yen did this and the dollar did that and the infrastructure did the other thing, we would still be dead.
cues.zh: 就算日元这样、美元那样，基础设施也发生变化，我们还是死路一条。

cues.en: We're just not broke. And do you know the surest way to go broke?
cues.zh: 只是还没破产。你知道破产最快的方法是什么吗？

cues.en: Keep getting an increasing share of a shrinking market.
cues.zh: 在萎缩的市场里，不断抢占更大的份额。

cues.en: at one time, there must have been dozens of companies making buggy whips.
cues.zh: 曾经肯定有几十家公司在生产马鞭。

cues.en: And I'll bet the last company around was the one that made the best goddamn buggy whip you ever saw.
cues.zh: 我敢打赌，撑到最后的那家，做出来的绝对是你见过最好的马鞭。

cues.en: Now how would you have liked to been a stockholder in that company? You
cues.zh: 但要是让你当那家公司的股东，你乐意吗？你们

cues.en: invested in a business, and this business is dead.
cues.zh: 投资了一门生意，而这门生意已经死了。

cues.en: collect the insurance, and invest in something with a future.
cues.zh: 领了保险金，然后去投资有未来的东西吧。

cues.en: but we can't, goes the prayer.
cues.zh: 但祈祷声又说，我们不能这么做。

cues.en: We can't because we have responsibility.
cues.zh: 我们不能，因为我们肩负责任。

cues.en: have no responsibility to them. For the last ten years, this company bled your money.
cues.zh: 对他们没有任何责任。过去十年里，这家公司一直在让你们的钱打水漂。

cues.en: Did this community ever say, we know times are tough.
cues.zh: 这个社区可曾说过，我们知道日子不好过，

cues.en: Check it out. You're paying twice what you did ten years ago.
cues.zh: 看看这个。你付的钱是十年前的两倍。

cues.en: And our devoted employees who have taken no increases for the past three years are still making twice what they made ten years ago. And our stock,
cues.zh: 而我们忠诚的员工，过去三年没涨过工资，现在挣的仍是十年前的两倍。还有我们的股票，

cues.en: what it was ten years ago.
Unless we forget, that's the only reason any of you became stockholders in the first place.
cues.zh: 除非我们忘了，这就是你们所有人当初成为股东的唯一原因。

cues.en: You don't care if they manufacture wire and cable, fried chicken, or grow tangerines.
cues.zh: 你不在乎他们生产的是电线电缆、炸鸡，还是种橘子。

cues.en: I'm the only friend you've got. I'm making you money.
cues.zh: 我是你唯一的朋友。我在帮你赚钱。

cues.en: maybe you'll get lucky, and it'll be used productively.
cues.zh: 也许你会走运，它会被有效利用。

cues.en: you'll create new jobs and provide a service for the economy, and God forbid,
cues.zh: 你会创造新就业岗位，为经济提供服务，而且，但愿不会，

cues.en: even make a few bucks for yourselves.
cues.zh: 甚至你们自己还能赚点钱。

cues.en: tell them you gave it the plant.
cues.zh: 就说是你把它弄成这样的。

cues.en: by the way, it pleases me that I'm called

cues.zh: 知道为什么吗，各位股东？

cues.en: you'll leave with a smile on your face and a few bucks in your pocket. Now that's a funeral worth having.
cues.zh: 你们离开时脸上挂着笑，口袋里还揣着几块钱。这才算得上是一场值得办的葬礼。
